---
name: Feature request
about: An idea for something the mod could do, or a setting you are missing
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like the mod to do?**


**When would it help?** (the situation in game: which race, which mission or map, what you find yourself clicking too
often)


**How should it behave by default?** Everything in this mod ships off or neutral, so say what the setting should do
once it is switched on, and anything it must never do.


**Anything it should leave alone?** (units, buildings, spells or missions where it would be a nuisance)


Good to know: the mod only changes single-player games and it can only do what the game itself can do. If an idea
needs something the engine does not have, I will say so in the issue rather than leave it open.
